from PIL import Image, ImageChops
im1=Image.open('/workspace/.tmp/seek_during.png').convert('RGB')
im2=Image.open('/workspace/.tmp/seek_post.png').convert('RGB')
d=ImageChops.difference(im1,im2)
# compute bbox of differences
bbox=d.getbbox()
print('diff bbox',bbox)
# crop center area where old HUD would appear (center)
center= (im1.size[0]*0.35, im1.size[1]*0.35, im1.size[0]*0.65, im1.size[1]*0.65)
cc1=im1.crop(center); cc2=im2.crop(center)
d2=ImageChops.difference(cc1,cc2)
print('center diff bbox',d2.getbbox())
# crop bottom crumb area
bottom=(0, im1.size[1]-120, im1.size[0], im1.size[1])
cb1=im1.crop(bottom); cb2=im2.crop(bottom)
d3=ImageChops.difference(cb1,cb2)
print('bottom diff bbox',d3.getbbox())
PY
